q: In Figure 36 (SMP-3 angle detection), how is the magnet's N-S pole axis oriented relative to the sensor package at the position labelled "~90 Deg.", compared with the one labelled "~0 Deg."?
options_raw: Rotated a quarter turn: at ~90 Deg. the N-S axis is vertical with N on top and S below, whereas at ~0 Deg. it is horizontal with S on the left and N on the right
Rotated a quarter turn the other way: at ~90 Deg. the N-S axis is vertical with S on top and N below
Unchanged: the N-S axis is horizontal in both, with S on the left and N on the right
Flipped in the plane: the N-S axis stays horizontal but N moves to the left and S to the right
fact: The four package drawings inside the boxed figure each carry a two-tone magnet disc; the ~0 Deg. one (top left) is split left/right with S left and N right, while the ~90 Deg. one (top right) is split top/bottom with N above and S below.
why_arbitrary: Nothing fixes which pole a vendor draws upward at its own nominal 90 degree position - the figure's own footnote says there is no absolute reference for the angular information.

q: In Figure 6-10 (Four-Channel PAM Multiplex System Diagram), which device's outputs connect directly to the control pins that switch the four-channel CD4066B analog switches?
stem_edit: Replaced "which device supplies the sequential channel-select signals that switch" with "which device's outputs connect directly to the control pins that switch", because the page shows a chain (CD4018B counter -> CD4049B inverters -> CD4001B gates -> CD4066B) in which more than one device could be called the source of the sequence.
options_raw: The CD4001B, whose outputs 3, 4, 10 and 11 run to CD4066B control pins 13, 5, 6 and 12
The CD4018B counter, whose Q1-bar and Q2-bar outputs run straight to the CD4066B control pins
The 1/3 CD4049B inverters, whose outputs run straight to the CD4066B control pins
The separate 1/4 CD4066B stage, whose pin 2 output runs to the four control pins
fact: In the left-hand half of Figure 6-10, four wires leave the CD4001B block at pins 3, 4, 10 and 11 and land on the circled control pins 13, 5, 6 and 12 above the four-channel CD4066B block; the CD4018B and CD4049B outputs terminate on CD4001B inputs instead.
why_arbitrary: The decoding could have been done in the counter or with different gate types; only tracing the drawn wires shows which package's outputs reach the switch control pins.
